$comment: Phase 91 Plan 1 (2026-06-25) — promoted from v0.1-provisional → v1.0. Added required event_id field for idempotency.
title: alert_candidate_created
description: Phase 91 canonical JSON Schema for alert_candidate_created envelope. event_id is the idempotency key — VM100 mission_control rejects duplicate POSTs with same event_id (returns 409).

alert_type.description: Category of alert for Phase 91 routing

producer_agent_id.description: Phase 89 agent that produced this candidate (e.g. phase89.macro_investigator)

subject_type.description: Entity type being alerted on (e.g. indicator, asset, belief)

b13_internal_severity.description: B13 internal severity that maps to the user-facing severity via Decision 13 boundary translation

confidence.description: Agent confidence in this alert candidate [0.0, 1.0]

explanation.description: Human-readable explanation of why this alert was raised

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when alert candidate was created

event_id.description: sha256-derived idempotency key (>= 16 chars). VM100 alert_trigger.event_id has UNIQUE constraint — duplicate POSTs return 409.

schema_version.description: Schema version — bumped to 1.0 by Phase 91 Plan 1 (2026-06-25)
